annotations.title: Today's outlook for a saved person

description: Today's planetary weather for one saved person, counted from their Moon sign: where the Moon is (and whether it is a Chandrashtama day to go slow), which houses Saturn, Jupiter, Rahu and Ketu occupy for them, and whether Sade Sati is running. Use when the user asks how today looks for them or someone saved, or whether today suits a plan. Read-only. Only for people saved on the user's AstroCalc account (needs a free AstroCalc sign-in); birth details typed in the chat work without sign-in in free_kundli, kundli_milan, explain_dasha, full_chart and life_timeline.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).

profile.description: A saved kundli on the user's AstroCalc account: its name as listed by my_profiles (e.g. 'Mummy') or its id.
